Noida Police Encounter: Four Suspects Arrested, Two Injured

In Noida's Sector 63, police engaged in an encounter with four suspects, resulting in two individuals sustaining gunshot wounds to their legs. The injured were arrested and hospitalized. Police also recovered illegal weapons and identified one of the arrested individuals as Vikas, described as a gangster.
